DIV5.HEAD: PART 195—TRANSPORTATION OF HAZARDOUS LIQUIDS BY PIPELINE

DIV8.HEAD: § 195.2 Definitions.
DIV8.P: Abandoned means permanently removed from service.
Gathering line means a pipeline 219.1 mm (85/8 in) or less nominal outside diameter that transports petroleum from a production facility.
Low-stress pipeline means a hazardous liquid pipeline that is operated in its entirety at a stress level of 20 percent or less, and that:
(1) Is not located in an offshore area; or
(2) Is located in an offshore area.

DIV8.HEAD: § 195.452 Pipeline integrity management in high consequence areas.
DIV8.P: (a) Which pipelines are covered? This section applies to each hazardous liquid pipeline that could affect a high consequence area.
(1) Category 1 includes pipelines existing on May 29, 2001.
(2) Category 2 includes pipelines constructed after May 29, 2001, as described in § 195.12.
